mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate starts (HOUST) signals growing demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200k and UNRATE MoM < 0, and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%, and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals growing consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO > 12mo MA and FEDFUNDS < 1%, and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
